zh.title: 完成、合法与安全：三个指标为何不能互相代替
zh.summary: 两个固定版本的评估模块显示，目标全达成可以与验收失败并存，合法计划也可以同时记录安全违规。合成输入揭示的是指标检查范围，不能当作完整系统复现。

en.title: An AI says “approved and passed.” What counts as proof?
en.summary: The same success report produced different observations with missing, failed, or successful execution records. Even a successful process did not become a verified assertion count or approval.
